asserts: Publishing a key that is already live in the same scope is rejected. The offending plugin rolls back to FAILED; the incumbent service and its dependents are undisturbed. isolate() is the sanctioned way to run a second implementation.
regression_note: Added 2026-08-25 from review. Python's provide-disposer restored the previous value unconditionally, so an earlier provider unloading CLOBBERED a live later one and a later one unloading RESURRECTED the dead earlier one. TypeScript guarded against clobbering but never restored. No fixture mounted two providers of one key, so neither behavior was reachable.
